specs.Connector Type: USB Type A, USB Type C

features: You can use these wires for different situation, like office, car, bed and etc., and they can be used to other USB C devices as well. Meanwhile, you can share the cables to others when they need.
The Type C warp cable has built-in smart chip and extra copper pin in the A connector which support 5A to 6.5A current max. And the data transmission can reach 480Mbps.
Reversible plug orientation, incorporating a differentiated injection method to make the pins on the connector more solid.

This for one-plus warp charger cable fits for one-plus wall charger and car charger perfectly indoor and in car. Please note that this one-plus charger cable will only deliver 2A~3A current for other cell phones.
Dash Type C USB Data Cable is with extremly fast charge speed.
